Introduction

Hello world! This is my first blog post built with Jekyll and Markdown. Jekyll parses this text file and automatically compiles it into a static HTML page.

Formatting Options

You can easily format your text using normal Markdown syntax:

  • Italics for subtle highlights
  • Inline code block for code snippets
